_meta.title: LOCKED confirmatory grid for the dtasamplesize BAM joint-assurance estimand
_meta.status: PRE-REGISTERED. Written and hashed BEFORE execution. Not to be edited after results are seen. If the implementation fails here, that failure IS the result.

_meta.mc_budget_rule: MCSE = sqrt(p(1-p)/B). Grid sweeps: B = 40000 (MCSE ~ 0.0020 near p=0.8). Confirmation of the three sizes N-1/N/N+1 in each scenario: B = 160000 (MCSE ~ 0.0010). No larger budget anywhere.

scenarios.intended_as: INFEASIBLE within N_range: must NOT return an apparently valid size

confirmation_protocol.step_4_N_minus_1_N_N_plus_1: For every scenario the package's N_total is taken, then the assurance at N-1, N, N+1 is evaluated INDEPENDENTLY by the Python reference (closed form), by exhaustive enumeration where enumerable, and by Monte Carlo at B=160000 seed 70117. PASS requires A(N) >= target AND A(N-1) < target.
confirmation_protocol.step_2_exhaustive: For the enumerable scenarios (C09,C10,C11) every N in [N_lo, N_hi] is additionally evaluated by full 3-D Gauss-Jacobi quadrature of the raw generative model and by exhaustive (n_d, x, y) triple enumeration.

PT1_target_monotone.rule: A larger target_assurance must NEVER return a smaller N.

PT2_delta_monotone.rule: Stricter (smaller) width margins must NEVER return a smaller N.
PT2_delta_monotone.not_found_rule: If no N in [N_lo, N_hi] reaches the target, N is recorded as +Inf for the purpose of the monotonicity comparison.

PT3_infeasible.rule: Scenario C12 is unreachable within its N_range. The package must not present a size as if it met the target: it must warn AND its reported joint_assurance must be < target.

PT4_reproducible_seed.rule: Two calls with method='monte_carlo' and the same seed must give bit-identical N_total and joint_assurance; two calls with different seeds are allowed to differ.

PT5_rng_state_restored.rule: After a call to bam_sample_size, .Random.seed in the calling session must be identical to its value before the call, for BOTH methods; and a subsequent runif() draw must be unaffected.

PT6_seed_irrelevant_under_exact.rule: Under method='exact' the headline N_total and joint_assurance must not depend on seed or on B.
